description: This file implements the connection logic between BiDi and CDP protocols, including classes for transport and connection management, and a function to establish a BiDi over CDP connection.

classes.name: BidiTransportImpl
classes.description: Implements the BidiTransport interface, managing message handling and connection reference.

classes.name: BidiConnection
classes.description: Implements the ConnectionTransport interface, managing message sending, receiving, and connection lifecycle.

classes.name: CdpTransportImpl
classes.description: Implements the bidiTransport.Transport interface, handling message translation between CDP and BiDi protocols.

methods.name: connectBidiOverCdp
methods.description: Establishes a BiDi over CDP connection, setting up transport and server components.

methods.name: setOnMessage
methods.description: Sets the message handler for BidiTransportImpl.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a ProtocolRequest message via BidiConnection.
